response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong technical leadership, software craftsmanship, and mentoring capabilities, he falls significantly short on the core technical requirements. The role explicitly requires 8 years of C++ programming experience; this candidate has only approximately 6 months of documented C++ work at National Instruments. His career has been primarily focused on web/application development (Node.js, TypeScript) and higher-level infrastructure, rather than systems-level programming needed for a cloud compute platform. Although he has valuable large-scale systems experience at Dunnhumby and infrastructure tooling knowledge, these do not compensate for the critical C++ specialization gap.
strengths: Proven mentoring and teaching ability demonstrated through workshops, code katas, and conference talks at major events like FOSS4G
Experience with large-scale distributed systems, having worked on micro-services handling millions of HTTP requests per second at Dunnhumby
Strong software craftsmanship advocate with demonstrated expertise in TDD, CI/CD, code quality, and establishing engineering best practices
concerns: Critical gap in required C++ expertise: only ~6 months of documented C++ experience versus the minimum requirement of 8 years
Career trajectory primarily in web/application development (Node.js, TypeScript) rather than systems programming and cloud compute platforms
Limited evidence of technical leadership specifically mentoring cloud or DevOps engineers in compute infrastructure roles
